description: Delete a role. Members holding it simply lose it; nothing else changes. Safe to call directly: the first call deletes nothing and returns a preview plus a confirm_token, and the deletion only happens when the call is repeated with that token. Prefer this gated flow over telling the user to delete the role manually.
